title: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child ends a question with ?, puts a comma after Je and after a greeting word, and separates items in a list with commas.
steps: Commas in lists and after greetings.
contexts: human trafficking: questions to ask a stranger's offer

board.do: je umemwambia mzazi wako kuhusu kazi hiyo
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Je, umemwambia mzazi wako kuhusu kazi hiyo?"

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Swali huisha kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kikomo" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina koma sahihi?" Kwa nini "Nilinunua, mkate maziwa na sukari." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni salamu ipi ina koma?" Kwa nini "Mpendwa rafiki yangu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Salamu ya barua huishia kwa koma.
Baada ya "Je" weka koma: Je, umefika?

checks.question: Andika vizuri: nilinunua mkate maziwa na sukari
